title: Item:Dust of Reaper Power
wikitext:
__NOTOC__ * All Dusts of Reaper Power are Bound to Account on Acquire. * Dusts of Reaper Power will disappear from player inventories when [[Sterling's Remnant Rush]], the event they drop from, ends on April 1st, 2027. Upgraded items do not lose their abilities. == Shared Mechanics == * Can be applied to random generated items, Essence Crafted items, standard named items, and raid items. * Can not overwrite an existing Reaper bonus already on an item. * The Reaper bonus applied is the slot-specific bonus rather than the standard ones that can appear on any item. * Can not be used on cosmetic items. == Dust of Reaper Power: Boots == {{Consumable | name = Dust of Reaper Power: Boots | picdesc = Dust of Reaper Power Boots.png | acquired = [[Sterling the Strongbox]] | location =
